healthRule.text: One scan-health strip replaces the three stacked banners (partial scan, repository changed mid-scan, lens failed). Each problem is one line with its own fix; the strip is absent on a clean scan. No heading: a repository change mid-scan is not an incomplete scan, so a shared 'incomplete' title would be false.

ctaRule.text: The accent is spent once per screen: Start investigation. Re-scan drops to a secondary button. While an investigation runs, the primary button opens that run instead of starting another. A cancelled or failed run keeps Open run; an orphaned one (run deleted) drops it. A finished run adds 'Addressed by <run>' as the first dismiss reason.

collectorRule.text: One collector list serves the empty state, the live progress and the coverage popover, so the six collectors and what each examines are stated in one place.
